Council Meetings

Council Meetings provide an opportunity for Councillors to discuss local issues, consider reports and make decisions on projects, services and priorities for the Central Highlands community.

Meetings are held from 5.00pm, with Public Question Time from 5.30pm, giving residents the opportunity to raise matters directly with Council. Community members are welcome to attend.

Meetings are held alternately at:

  • 19 Alexander Street, Bothwell
  • 6 Tarleton Street, Hamilton

Following the October elections, meeting dates and times for the remainder of the financial year will be published on this website.

Council Workshops

Council Workshops are generally held at Bothwell on the first Tuesday of each month from 9.00am. Additional workshops may be held as required.

Workshops are not open to the public and are used for information sharing and discussion. Any changes to the meeting or workshop schedule will be publicly advertised.
